content: {"paper_id":"W7123344170","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"A ‘low-rank + sparse’ model is established to formulate the received signal via a Joint Space-Time (JST)-Stable Principal Component Pursuit (SPCP)-decomposition framework.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文显式建立‘低秩+稀疏’模型，并利用信号矩阵的低秩结构/分解来表示接收信号，满足低秩建模定义。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"sparse-representation","reason_zh":"仅见‘low-rank + sparse’模型与SPCP分解，未说明以字典原子、基向量或潜在特征表达样本，稀疏项角色不足，难以确定满足稀疏表示定义。"}],"input_issues":[]}
